brief.text: Design a roughly 3.2 m deep-ocean survey vehicle with a curved teardrop hull, deep teal structure, warm ivory fairing and sparse amber accents. Integrate a recessed forward port, asymmetric sensor and buoyancy modules, guarded thrusters and an articulated sampling arm. Review its silhouette, underside and arm attachment, then repair a visible weakness by source reference.

revisions.title: Initial design
revisions.description: First retained design with the curved hull, survey equipment and articulated arm.

revisions.title: Arm attachment revision
revisions.description: Moved the shoulder mount, adjusted its plate and supports, added mounting bolts and rerouted the service cable after close-up review.

revisions.title: Current gallery revision
revisions.description: Adjusted the runner support endpoints to meet the hull. This is the source used for the current downloadable asset; mechanical clearance is not certified.
